entities.summary: Tsuyoshi Shinjo , also known during the 2022 Nippon Professional Baseball season as BIGBOSS , is a former Japanese professional baseball outfielder and the current manager for the Hokkaido Nippon-Ham Fighters of Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB).
